inputs.label: Unused Flipper Column Lower Right End-of-Stroke (81)

physical.notes: PinMAME flipper switch column (CORE_FLIPPERSWCOL, internal column 11), bit CORE_SWLRFLIPEOSBIT = 0x01, published at 81 through core_swSeq2m(n) = n + 7. locals.flipMask carries this end-of-stroke bit only when hw.flippers sets FLIP_EOS (implied by FLIP_SOL), and FLIP_SWNO(58,57) sets neither, so core_updateSw neither synthesizes it nor copies it anywhere: PinMAME models no end-of-stroke switch on this machine. A host write survives in the column, but the ROM cannot read it there: s11.c's pia4a_r reads the switch matrix only through core_getSwCol with an eight-bit column strobe, which reaches columns 1-8.

inputs.label: Lower Right Flipper Button (PinMAME Flipper Column)

physical.notes: PinMAME flipper switch column (CORE_FLIPPERSWCOL, internal column 11), bit CORE_SWLRFLIPBUTBIT = 0x02, published at 82 through core_swSeq2m(n) = n + 7. This is the lower right cabinet flipper button as the ROM receives it. The driver declares FLIP_SWNO(58,57) with no FLIP_SOL, so with keyboard handling off (the LibPinMAME default) core_updateSw reads this bit as the host wrote it and, on every update, copies it into matrix switch 57 through core_setSw and fabricates the synthetic 45/46 flipper outputs from it while the switched-solenoid enable is on. Drive this address, not 57: a host write to 57 is overwritten on the next update. PDF 45 lists the separate SW-10A-48 cabinet button for each side.

mechanisms.behavior: The drain feeds the under-apron runway. A settled ball closes 10. Output 1 kicks it to the manual shooter lane, which has its own switch 14.
mechanisms.label: Outhole and Single-Ball Trough

mechanisms.behavior: A ball settles in the molded Doghouse pocket and closes 22. The kick arm releases it back to the playfield when 3 pulses.
mechanisms.label: Doghouse Kickbig

mechanisms.behavior: A ball in the garbage-can eject hole closes Fish Collect 24. Coil 5 kicks the ball out toward the upper playfield.
mechanisms.label: Garbage Can Eject

mechanisms.behavior: Five latching blades report their lowered states through C-13239. Reset coil 6 lifts the bank and clears the target states.
mechanisms.label: Five-Bird Drop Target Bank

mechanisms.behavior: Three latching blades report their lowered states through the C-12559 opto board. Reset coil 4 lifts the bank and clears the target states.
mechanisms.label: Three-Milk-Bottle Drop Target Bank

mechanisms.behavior: The ball moves a sprung target arm through a sensing region. The ROM counts the opto's transitions, and the VPX uses a moving stand-in.
mechanisms.label: Fish Bone-Us Linear Target

mechanisms.behavior: Two phases drive one stepper under an eight-position wheel. Test 08 reports a home opto and a nominal count of 1–200, and spins to the next counterclockwise position.
mechanisms.label: Seafood Wheel

mechanisms.behavior: The insert-board feature has separate motors for the cat and woman. Test 09 exercises them independently.
mechanisms.label: Cat and Broom Animation

mechanisms.behavior: The ramp entrance and exit each have a switch. The ramp guides the ball around the rear of the playfield.
mechanisms.label: Tiger Ramp Gates

mechanisms.behavior: The Goldfish ramp has separate entrance and exit contacts. The ramp rises above the playfield and returns the ball on its wireform.
mechanisms.label: Center Ramp Gates

mechanisms.behavior: The skirt closes the bumper contact and its coil snaps the bumper ring down.
mechanisms.label: Left Jet Bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The skirt closes the bumper contact and its coil snaps the bumper ring down.
mechanisms.label: Right Jet Bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The skirt closes the bumper contact and its coil snaps the bumper ring down.
mechanisms.label: Lower Jet Bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Rubber movement closes the paired switch assembly and the kick arm deforms the rubber outward.
mechanisms.label: Left Slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: Rubber movement closes the paired switch assembly and the kick arm deforms the rubber outward.
mechanisms.label: Right Slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: The cabinet button operates the power and hold coil circuit. Lane-change monitor 58 follows its actuation.
mechanisms.label: Lower Left Flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The cabinet button operates the power and hold coil circuit. Lane-change monitor 57 follows its actuation.
mechanisms.label: Lower Right Flipper

A playfield-mounted C-11998-1 relay switches the playfield illumination. System 11 has no separate public GI-string group.
The second C-11998-1 relay is on the backbox insert board and switches backbox illumination.
D-12247 carries this relay. It selects the C side and PinMAME reports its state back at switch 2.
The wiring table prints four #89 backbox lamps. The abbreviated location list prints #906.
